mbm-0743.clue: I race my own shadow in the pool.
mbm-0743.quote: In the outdoor lane my shadow swims on the bottom ahead of me. At the far wall we meet for one second. I don't think either of us has won yet.

mbm-0744.clue: I dance the last bar after the music stops.
mbm-0744.quote: Our practice record has a scratch that swallows the final bar of the waltz. We finish in the silence. At our first live dance we nearly bowed a whole bar early out of habit.

mbm-0745.clue: I sent our court a postcard.
mbm-0745.quote: I learned beach volleyball on a court with one post painted turquoise. When I moved inland my old partner mailed a photo of it in the rain. I mailed one back of my new net with a turquoise ribbon on the post.

mbm-0746.clue: I play the game with the broken bridge.
mbm-0746.quote: The little sprite can leap the gap if I stand on the very last pixel. My cousin found the spot with his finger on the glass. The smudge lasted longer than our high score.

mbm-0747.clue: I keep the park's spare black knight.
mbm-0747.quote: Our stone chess table has a dip that swallowed a piece on a windy afternoon. I turned up next week with a knight whittled from dark wood. The old regulars promoted me to quartermaster.

mbm-0748.clue: I choose my sunshine by its soundtrack.
mbm-0748.quote: One end of the beach has gulls, the middle has the ice cream cart, and the quiet end has small waves rattling pebbles. I spread my towel where I can just hear all three.

mbm-0749.clue: The sail folds down when you need a pillow.
mbm-0749.quote: I sewed a little red sail onto our picnic quilt. Dad wanted a pillow, so he pulled the loop and the sail lay flat under his ear. He slept through the whole regatta.

mbm-0750.clue: I like two-player games with one keyboard.
mbm-0750.quote: My brother and I sit so close our elbows keep voting on each other's moves. We finally cleared the castle by leaning opposite ways together. Anyone watching would have sworn we were steering a canoe.
